Affenpinscher.exercise_needs: Moderate (30-45 mins daily walking and indoor play)
Affenpinscher.grooming_needs: High (Dense wiry black coat, weekly brushing, facial mustache/beard grooming)
Affenpinscher.diet_guide: High-protein small-breed formula with Omega-3 and Omega-6 fatty acids for wiry coat health. Feed 2-3 portioned meals daily.
Affenpinscher.ideal_caretaker: Attentive, patient caretakers who appreciate charming, spirited small dogs with big personalities.
Affenpinscher.care_tips: Famous for their comical human-like bearded facial expression. Keep on a harness to protect delicate trachea and brush their mustache after meals.

Labrador Retriever.diet_guide: High-protein formula with controlled calories to prevent obesity and joint strain.
Labrador Retriever.ideal_caretaker: Energetic caretakers who enjoy outdoor walking, fetch, and swimming.
Labrador Retriever.care_tips: Prone to hip dysplasia and overeating. Maintain structured exercise and strict portion control.

Golden Retriever.diet_guide: Omega-3 rich diet for dense lustrous golden coat and cardiac support.
Golden Retriever.ideal_caretaker: Loving families or attentive sitters who provide daily brushing and companionship.
Golden Retriever.care_tips: Check ears regularly for moisture/infection after swimming. Provide daily mental stimulation.

German Shepherd.diet_guide: Large-breed formula with glucosamine and easily digestible proteins.
German Shepherd.ideal_caretaker: Experienced caretakers comfortable with working breeds and structured routines.
German Shepherd.care_tips: Requires early socialization and agility/obedience work to channel protective instincts.

Beagle.diet_guide: Portion-controlled balanced food; hound scent drive makes them food scavengers.
Beagle.ideal_caretaker: Securely fenced yard sitters who keep leashes secure during scent walks.
Beagle.care_tips: Always walk on leash as their powerful sense of smell can lead them to wander.

French Bulldog.exercise_needs: Low to Moderate (20-30 mins relaxed walking)
French Bulldog.diet_guide: Hypoallergenic kibble with anti-flatulence prebiotic fiber.
French Bulldog.ideal_caretaker: Indoor apartment caretakers with air-conditioned spaces.
French Bulldog.care_tips: Brachycephalic breed: avoid excessive heat, humidity, and intense exercise.

Pug.exercise_needs: Low to Moderate (20-30 mins easy walking)
Pug.grooming_needs: Moderate (Clean facial wrinkles daily, brush short shedding coat)
Pug.diet_guide: Strict calorie control; high tendency for weight gain.
Pug.ideal_caretaker: Gentle sitters who enjoy indoor cuddles and relaxed strolling.
Pug.care_tips: Keep facial folds clean and dry to prevent skin fold dermatitis.

Shih Tzu.grooming_needs: Very High (Daily brushing for long flowing coat)
Shih Tzu.diet_guide: Small-breed kibble with omega fatty acids for coat softness.
Shih Tzu.ideal_caretaker: Caretakers experienced with toy breeds and daily coat maintenance.
Shih Tzu.care_tips: Keep hair out of eyes with topknots or puppy cuts. Clean eye corners daily.

Poodle.grooming_needs: Very High (Professional clipping every 4-6 weeks, hypoallergenic)
Poodle.diet_guide: Nutrient-dense protein with specific kibble shapes for oral hygiene.
Poodle.ideal_caretaker: Caretakers experienced with mental puzzles and hypoallergenic grooming.
Poodle.care_tips: Daily brushing required to prevent curl matting. Highly responsive to positive reinforcement.

Siberian Husky.grooming_needs: High (Double coat blowouts twice a year, never shave)
Siberian Husky.diet_guide: High-fat, high-protein working dog food with high caloric density.
Siberian Husky.ideal_caretaker: Active runners or hikers with escape-proof high fencing.
Siberian Husky.care_tips: Escape artists! Ensure sturdy enclosures and avoid hot sun exposure.

Boxer.diet_guide: High-protein formula with L-carnitine and taurine for cardiac muscle health.
Boxer.ideal_caretaker: Energetic caretakers who enjoy interactive play and strength games.
Boxer.care_tips: Deep-chested breed: prevent strenuous activity right after feeding to avoid bloat.

Rottweiler.diet_guide: Large-breed growth and maintenance formula with high calcium and phosphorus.
Rottweiler.ideal_caretaker: Experienced dog handlers who maintain firm, kind leadership.
Rottweiler.care_tips: Early positive socialization is vital. They are gentle guardians with their families.

Doberman Pinscher.diet_guide: High-protein athletic food with joint and heart health supplements.
Doberman Pinscher.ideal_caretaker: Active pet parents who provide consistent training and companionship.
Doberman Pinscher.care_tips: Thrives on being part of the household; does not tolerate cold weather well.

Scottish Terrier.grooming_needs: High (Wiry outer coat, dense undercoat, beard trimming)
Scottish Terrier.diet_guide: Balanced small-breed formula with zinc and biotin for wiry coat health.
Scottish Terrier.ideal_caretaker: Caretakers who appreciate feisty, dignified terrier spirit.
Scottish Terrier.care_tips: Strong prey drive for small rodents. Brush facial beard weekly.

Miniature Schnauzer.grooming_needs: High (Distinctive beard, bushy eyebrows, wiry coat)
Miniature Schnauzer.diet_guide: Low-fat, high-quality formula (prone to hyperlipidemia and pancreatitis).
Miniature Schnauzer.ideal_caretaker: Active families looking for a smart, low-shedding companion.
Miniature Schnauzer.care_tips: Avoid high-fat table treats to protect their pancreas. Wipe beard after wet meals.

Persian Cat.exercise_needs: Low (Calm indoor play and relaxing in cozy sunspots)
Persian Cat.grooming_needs: High (Daily combing to prevent mats, eye corner cleaning)
Persian Cat.diet_guide: Hairball-control high-protein diet with omega oils for a plush luxurious coat.
Persian Cat.ideal_caretaker: Serene, calm indoor households looking for a gentle, affectionate lap companion.
Persian Cat.care_tips: Requires daily coat grooming and gentle face wiping around nasal folds.

Siamese Cat.exercise_needs: Moderate to High (Loves interactive games, fetch, and conversational bonding)

Siamese Cat.diet_guide: Lean protein feline diet supporting active metabolism and slender body condition.
Siamese Cat.ideal_caretaker: Families who enjoy an outgoing, highly talkative, and loving feline partner.
Siamese Cat.care_tips: Deeply social; best in pairs or with owners who spend plenty of time at home.

Maine Coon.care_tips: One of the largest domesticated cat breeds; distinctive lynx-tipped ears and bushy tail.
